prompt: I turned down the job in Leeds, so I still live far from my sister. If I had taken the job, I ___ near her now.
explanation_ru: Условие относится к прошлому (had taken), а результат — к настоящему (now): would live, а не would have lived.

prompt: Last week Idris did not back up his files, so he lost his essay. Now he is very stressed.
explanation_ru: Прошлое условие (had backed up) и результат в настоящем (now): would not be, без have been.
options: If Idris had backed up his files, he would not have been so stressed now.
If Idris backed up his files, he would not have been so stressed.
If Idris had backed up his files, he would not be so stressed now.
If Idris would back up his files, he would not be so stressed now.
answer: If Idris had backed up his files, he would not be so stressed now.

prompt: Hamid wishes he could play in the school team.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Wish + could означает, что сейчас сделать что-то нельзя, а хочется: Hamid не может играть в команде.
options: Hamid is able to play in the school team.
Hamid can't play in the school team now, and he is sorry.
Hamid couldn't play in the team last year, but he can now.
Hamid doesn't want to play in the school team.
answer: Hamid can't play in the school team now, and he is sorry.
